Seychelles School Holiday Program – FAQ

When is the school holiday program in Seychelles?

The December 2026 program runs 7–21 December 2026 (Saturdays included) and ends with an Exhibition Show on 20 December 2026. April and August 2027 programs follow the Seychelles school holidays; dates are confirmed once the Ministry of Education calendar is final.

What ages can join the holiday dance program?

Children and teens aged 3 to 16 in four groups: Juvenile (3–6), Kids (7–10), Junior (11–13) and Teen (14–16). Each group is limited to 10 children.

How much does the holiday program cost?

The December 2026 Full Pass is SCR 1,800.00 and includes supplementary snacks.

Where is XVision Dance Studio?

XVision Dance Studio is at Providence Zone 18, 3rd Floor, Mahé, Seychelles. Call +248 2663425 or email xvisiondanceseychelles@gmail.com.

What does the program include?

Dance Theatre (ballet, jazz, hip hop, contemporary, Latin and more), Theatre Arts, an Outdoor Day, Team Building and a final Exhibition Show for families.

How do I register my child?

Complete the registration form on this page, then pay the program fee before classes start and email proof of payment to xvisiondanceseychelles@gmail.com. Places are limited to 10 per group.

Indemnity, Waiver & Terms

  1. Assumption of risk. I understand dance, theatre, physical conditioning, outdoor activities and excursions carry inherent risks including strains, sprains, falls, collisions, fatigue and other injury. I voluntarily accept these risks on behalf of my child.
  2. Indemnity. To the fullest extent permitted by Seychelles law, I release, waive and hold harmless XVision Dance Studio, its owners, directors, instructors, staff, volunteers, assistants and venue hosts from any claim, loss, damage, cost, injury, illness or death arising from my child's participation, except where caused by proven gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
  3. Outdoor Day. I consent to my child joining outdoor days and any transport arranged. I accept the added risks of nature, sea, sun, terrain and weather, and I will ensure my child is fit to take part.
  4. Medical. I have disclosed all conditions, allergies and injuries. I authorise staff to obtain emergency first aid and medical treatment, and I accept responsibility for related costs. I will keep my child at home if unwell.
  5. Property. The studio is not liable for loss, theft or damage to personal belongings, phones, jewellery or valuables. Children should bring nothing of high value.
  6. Props & equipment. The parent/guardian is responsible for supplying and maintaining any props or equipment specifically needed for the child to learn. Unsafe or unsuitable items (e.g. incorrect footwear) may limit participation without refund.
  7. Conduct. Children must follow instructions and respect staff, peers and premises. The studio may suspend a child for unsafe or disruptive behaviour without refund. I accept liability for damage caused by my child.
  8. Drop-off & pick-up. Children must be collected on time by me or an authorised person named in the form. The studio is not responsible for children before or after program hours.
  9. Media. Where I have consented, I allow photographs, video and the exhibition show to be recorded and used for studio promotion without compensation.
  10. Fees, payment & places. Places are limited to 10 per group. Fees must be paid before the student starts classes each month. XVision Dance Studio does not have a refund policy: all fees paid are final, non-refundable and non-transferable. The studio may alter schedules, merge groups or change instructors where necessary.
  11. Governing law. This agreement is governed by the laws of Seychelles and binds my heirs and legal representatives. Submitting the registration is my signed agreement.
